name: BetBoom
verdict: Owned by OOO Asna-Grupp (50%) and OOO BK 369 (50%); RB Business named Marina Danilova and Arman Ovsepyan as ultimate beneficiaries (EGRUL data, 2021). Nothing found.
note: Bookmaker; legal entity OOO Firma STOM per the company's own trademark page (betboom.ru/pages/tovznak). Premium partner of FC Lokomotiv since July 2024 (4-year deal); on the front right chest and the back of the 2026-27 home shirt. Ownership data is from RB Business, 9 Aug 2021 (EGRUL-based); no newer reporting found. No human-rights findings located.
